title: A Spectral Local-to-Global Principle for Spin Systems on Graphs with Girth At Least Five
summary: It is proved that, for every $δ\in (0,1)$, the Glauber dynamics for the uniform distribution on proper $q$-colorings is rapidly mixing when $q \geq (1+δ)Δ$ and the underlying graph has girth at least $5$ and maximum degree $Δ= Ω_δ(1)$. This result also extends to general multi-spin systems satisfying a $\textit{local spectral contraction}$ condition, including the anti-ferromagnetic Potts model with $q\geq (1+δ)(1-β)Δ$.
